_meta.description: Personal places database. One entry per place. Rendered by places/build.py into places/index.html (map + location-aware cards) and exported to KML/CSV for Google My Maps.

schema.name: display name
schema.category: bar | restaurant | cafe | sight | shop | hotel | nightlife | other
schema.notes: why it's worth going, what to order, tips
schema.sources: URLs used to identify the place
schema.gmaps_query: optional: text Google Maps should search for the share link (defaults to name + address)

places.name: TICTACTOE Bangkok
places.address: 5th floor, EmSphere, 628 Sukhumvit Rd, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110
places.notes: Social 'dating bar' on EmSphere 5F built for meeting people; one drink order comes with two glasses. Budget roughly 400-1,000 THB. Daytime coffee session (~490 THB incl. two drinks) per Time Out. EmSphere is the mall with the Gourmet Market supermarket on the ground floor, 3-5 min walk from BTS Phrom Phong.
places.hours: Evening from 19:00 per The Standard; daytime coffee session per Time Out. Sources conflict, check before going.
